excerpt: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
content_html:
Pocket TTS — Greek (6 layers)

Greek and Cypriot Greek text-to-speech for Pocket TTS, running faster than real time on a CPU.

  • Trained on ~2,400 hours of Greek speech from 3,900+ speakers, balanced between female and male voices.
  • As intelligible as real speech: Whisper transcribes it as accurately as real recordings of the same sentences.
  • Voice cloning from a 10–15 s sample, plus eight curated voices, two of them Cypriot.
  • ~110 M parameters, 3× faster than real time on a laptop CPU, with streaming output.
  • Own Greek tokenizer, trained on correctly punctuated Greek text.

Voices

Every clip below was generated by this model, not recorded.

voice description sample
Eleni female, young adult, calm and warm
Athina female, young adult, clear and professional
Katerina female, adult, upbeat and expressive
Sophia female, young adult, Cypriot, bright and lively
Spyros male, adult, deep, calm and warm
Kostas male, young adult, clear and professional
Nikos male, adult, deep, upbeat and friendly
Giorgos male, mature, Cypriot, expressive

Use a voice by passing its file, e.g. --voice hf://myned-ai/pocket-tts-greek/voices/eleni.wav. Descriptions are approximate. voices/voices.md lists the source recording and the cleaning applied to each voice. The named English voices (alba, …) do not work with this model; any other clean recording of a speaker does.

Usage 

uvx pocket-tts generate \
  --config hf://myned-ai/pocket-tts-greek/greek.yaml \
  --voice hf://myned-ai/pocket-tts-greek/voices/kostas.wav \
  --text "Καλημέρα σας! Θέλετε να κλείσουμε ένα ραντεβού για αύριο;"

from pocket_tts import TTSModel

model = TTSModel.load_model(config="hf://myned-ai/pocket-tts-greek/greek.yaml")
voice = model.get_state_for_audio_prompt("hf://myned-ai/pocket-tts-greek/voices/eleni.wav")
audio = model.generate_audio(voice, "Γεια σας, πώς μπορώ να σας βοηθήσω;")
  • Questions end with ;, the Greek question mark. The config keeps it; do not convert it.
  • Write numbers as words for best results ("στις δέκα και μισή", not "στις 10:30").
  • Default temperature is 0.3; 0.5–0.7 gives livelier but less even delivery.
  • For your own voice: 10–15 s of one continuous, clean take, ideally with the speaking style you want. The model copies the recording's quality, room and pace.

Training

data 2,395 h of Greek speech, 766k utterances, 3,900+ speakers, 50 % female; 115 h Cypriot. Mostly Greek podcasts (automatically transcribed and aligned) plus Mozilla Common Voice (el, el-CY)
tokenizer SentencePiece, 4,000 tokens, trained on the transcripts
teacher 24 layers, fine-tuned from english_2026-04_24l with a fresh text embedding, 300k steps
student 6 layers, depth-distilled from the teacher (guidance baked in), 250k steps
punctuation The ASR marked questions with the Latin ? instead of the Greek question mark ;. We converted them to the correct Greek form before training.
hardware one GH200, ~23 h in total

Trained with the Pocket TTS training code.

Evaluation

80 Greek sentences from 10 Common Voice speakers never seen in training. The voice prompt is a different recording of the same speaker. Whisper large-v3 is the judge, at temperature 0.3.

this model real recordings
word error rate 11.2 % (one Whisper hallucination excluded) 12.5 %
speaker similarity (WavLM) 0.912 0.937 (two real clips)
UTMOS 2.98 2.46

Whisper misreads 12.5 % of words even in real Greek speech, and the test sentences are largely literary, so absolute error rates here are not comparable with English models.

Across the 8 voices × 59 agent-style sentences, 87 % of clips were read cleanly.

Limitations

  • Very short replies ("Εντάξει.", "Χαίρετε.") are the weakest case: about 1 in 5 comes out unclear. Prefer "Εντάξει, το κανονίζω." to a bare "Εντάξει.".
  • Questions rise at the end more weakly than in natural speech.
  • Rare words outside everyday conversation ("πλησιέστερο") are sometimes misread.
  • Cypriot could not be scored automatically, because Whisper misreads real Cypriot speech about 46 % of the time. It has been judged by ear only.
  • Voice cloning: only clone voices you have permission to use.

License

Weights: CC BY 4.0, the same as the base model kyutai/pocket-tts. Commercial use is allowed with attribution. The bundled voices are cut from Mozilla Common Voice (CC0) recordings; please do not attempt to identify the contributors. As upstream asks: do not use this model to impersonate people or to present generated audio as genuine recordings.

Pocket TTS — Greek (6 layers)

Greek and Cypriot Greek text-to-speech for Pocket TTS, running faster than real time on a CPU.

  • As intelligible as real speech: Whisper transcribes it as accurately as real recordings of the same sentences.
  • Voice cloning from a 10–15 s sample, plus eight curated voices, two of them Cypriot.
  • ~110 M parameters, 3× faster than real time on a laptop CPU, with streaming output.
  • Own Greek tokenizer, trained on correctly punctuated Greek text.
